s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the front disc brake caliper assembly LH from the steering knuckle.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the front disc brake caliper assembly LH with wire or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and remove the disc.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Front Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly Axial Play

s2.ptxt: Using a dial indicator, check the bearing axial play near the inner circumference (flange) of the axle hub.

atten3.ptxt: If it exceeds the maximum, replace the bearing with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Front Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly Runout

s2.ptxt: Using a dial indicator, check the axle hub runout near the outer circumference of the axle hub.

atten3.ptxt: If it exceeds the maximum, replace the hub & bearing with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Align the matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and install the disc.

atten3.ptxt: When replacing the disc, select the installation position where the disc runout is minimal.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the front disc brake caliper assembly LH to the steering knuckle with the 2 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and separate the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the caliper with wire or equivalent.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the caliper with wire or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and remove the disc.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly Axial Play

s2.ptxt: Using a dial indicator, check the bearing axial play near the inner circumference (flange) of the axle hub.

atten3.ptxt: If it exceeds the maximum, replace the bearing with a new one.

s2.ptxt: ) Align the matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and install the disc.

atten3.ptxt: When replacing the disc, select the installation position where the disc runout is minimal.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly Runout

s2.ptxt: Secure the rear disc with the hub nuts.
Using a dial indicator, inspect the runout at 10mm inside the outer edge of the rear disc.

atten3.ptxt: If the runout exceeds the limit, change the installation position of the disc relative to the axle hub so that the runout is minimized. If the runout still exceeds the limit after changing the position of the disc relative to the axle hub, machine the disc. If the thickness after machining is less than the disc thickness limit, replace the disc with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Install the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH to the rear axle carrier with the 2 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Install the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH with the 2 bolts.

atten3.ptxt: Do not twist the flexible hose.
